description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams used for filtering candidate history search results within the Recruitment plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies sorting options and filtering parameters such as candidate ID and action IDs.

classes.name: CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying search filter parameters related to candidate history, including sorting preferences and filtering criteria such as candidate ID and action IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the candidate ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getActionIds
methods.description: Returns the array of action IDs used for filtering.

methods.name: setActionIds
methods.description: Sets the array of action IDs used for filtering.
